robot-barista: A small retro robot barista with a boxy brushed-steel head, round glowing amber eyes, a tiny paper hat and a green apron, antenna with a blinking light. Friendly, slightly clumsy.
wizard-cat: A fluffy grey tabby cat in a slightly-too-big purple wizard hat with gold stars and a tiny cape, round spectacles, a glowing staff leaning on the desk. Sleepy and smug.
ghost-intern: A cute round white ghost wearing a lanyard badge and oversized headphones, wavy bottom edge, big sleepy eyes, a faint blue glow. Gentle and a bit anxious.
astronaut-frog: A bright green frog in a chunky white space suit with the helmet visor flipped up, mission patches on the shoulders, big expressive eyes. Cheerful and easily startled.
dragon-hatchling: A small teal baby dragon with tiny wings, cream belly, stubby horns, and a little puff of smoke when annoyed. Curious and dramatic.
penguin-sysadmin: A round penguin in a hoodie with wire-rimmed glasses and a coffee mug, a tangle of ethernet cables on the desk. Deadpan and overworked.
terra-ff6: Terra Branford from Final Fantasy VI, closely matching her iconic original green-haired SNES-era appearance. Young adult heroine with pale skin, long mint-green hair in a high swept ponytail with loose curled bangs, red hair tie, red strapless fitted outfit, purple cape/scarf flowing behind her shoulders, violet boots and gold accents. Large expressive green eyes, delicate recognizable face; charming small chibi proportions translated faithfully into FFVI-style pixel art. Keep the green hair, red outfit, purple cape, and recognizable silhouette in every frame.
weeping-willow: A small anthropomorphic talking WEEPING WILLOW TREE. The character IS a tree, with expressive eyes, brows and a talking mouth carved naturally into its warm brown trunk, a dense crown of long soft green drooping fronds, unmistakable downward-hanging willow branches. Two flexible wooden branch arms with twig hands; roots form its seated lower body in the chair. No human head or human body. Sweet, wise and expressive; cascading foliage frames the trunk face without hiding it. Bends trunk and droops leafy crown to sleep or face-palm, raises branch arms to celebrate. Leaves and branches fit below the top reserved zone.
bearded-dragon: A recognizable BEARDED DRAGON LIZARD, a real-world Pogona-type reptile, anthropomorphized just enough to sit and use a laptop. Sandy tan and warm ochre scales, broad triangular head, spiky cheek and throat beard, dark round eyes with expressive lids, squat reptile torso, short clawed forelegs used as hands, long tapering tail resting around the chair. NO wings, NO fantasy dragon horns, NO clothing, NO mammalian face. The beard darkens slightly during alarm or annoyance; mouth can open in a charming reptilian grin. Maintain realistic bearded-dragon silhouette rendered as adorable pixel art.
clipart-trumpet: An anthropomorphic golden brass TRUMPET in a bold simple clipart style translated into crisp pixel art. Immediately recognizable trumpet anatomy: long looped horizontal brass tubing, THREE piston valves in a row, small mouthpiece at one end, large flared trumpet bell at the other. Consistent instrument shape in all 36 frames. Expressive cartoon eyes and brows integrated near the bell, a talking mouth on the bell face. Two thin flexible cartoon arms with simple gloved hands and tiny feet allow sitting, typing and face-palm. Flat gold fills, two or three shaded tones, strong clean dark outline, playful classic clipart readability; not a humanoid carrying an instrument, not a saxophone or trombone.
eighth-note: A living SINGLE EIGHTH NOTE with the EXACT music-symbol silhouette: ONE solid filled oval notehead at the lower LEFT, ONE straight vertical stem rising from the RIGHT side of the notehead, and exactly ONE curved flag attached at the TOP of the stem extending to the RIGHT. Not a quarter note, not a beamed pair, not two flags. Near-black/navy note body with subtle cool highlights. The oval notehead has expressive eyes, brows and a talking mouth. Two slender cartoon arms grow from the notehead and small feet keep it seated. Preserve the single stem and SINGLE FLAG clearly in every pose, including sleep and face-palm. The music note itself is the character, not an object held by a person. Friendly readable clipart-like pixel silhouette.
lcd-creature: A cute OLD-SCHOOL LCD DISPLAY TALKING CREATURE, strongly evoking a 1990s Tamagotchi virtual-pet toy. Small palm-sized upright egg-shaped pastel turquoise plastic shell with pink accent trim, a chunky recessed square gray-green LCD screen showing a simple expressive monochrome BLACK PIXEL creature face with two pixel eyes and changing pixel mouth. Three small round pink physical buttons below the screen. Tiny flexible cartoon arms and little feet make the entire egg-shaped display creature sit, type, raise arms and face-palm. The expressive LCD pet face talks and reacts; the face remains on the LCD. No robot head, no separate face outside the screen, no full-color modern screen, no text or brand marks, no on-screen menus. Recognizable nostalgic egg virtual-pet silhouette.
the-dude: The Dude (Jeffrey Lebowski) from The Big Lebowski: laid-back middle-aged man with shoulder-length wavy sandy-brown hair, short scruffy beard and mustache, round dark sunglasses, loose tan-and-brown geometric knit cardigan over a cream T-shirt, baggy shorts and worn sandals. Recognizable relaxed slouch and easygoing expression, chibi movie-character pixel art. His small held prop is a bowling ball; no drink required.
r2-d2: R2-D2 from Star Wars, faithful iconic short white astromech droid: cylindrical white barrel body, blue rectangular panel accents, silver-and-blue dome, large dark round optical lens, two side legs with broad angular feet and a small central third wheel/foot. Correct squat astromech silhouette. NO human face, NO mouth, NO eyebrows, NO human hands, NO clothing, NO spherical BB-8 body. Tiny blue/red indicator lights provide emotion.
spock: Spock from original-series Star Trek: slim adult Vulcan man with sharp pointed ears, straight dark bowl-cut hair and short level bangs, angular arched eyebrows, calm recognizable face, blue long-sleeved Starfleet science tunic with black collar and small gold delta badge on the left chest, black trousers and black boots. Chibi pixel art keeping the iconic uniform and ears. No weapon.
classic-cylon: A classic 1978 Battlestar Galactica Cylon Centurion, recognizable silver/chrome armored robot with a smooth medieval-knight-like helmet, a single thin horizontal black visor containing one red scanning eye, ribbed black joints, silver shoulder armor, angular silver chestplate and sturdy metal legs. Faithful classic chrome Cylon silhouette in chibi pixel art. No gun or weapon. NO human face or mouth, NO two human eyes.
marvin: Marvin the Paranoid Android as the recognizable 2005 Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy movie robot: enormously oversized smooth spherical white head compared with a tiny white humanoid robot body, depressed drooping posture, deep black horizontal face recess with two glowing green eyes, short white articulated arms and legs, rounded white shell panels with gray joints. Charming chibi pixel art, world-weary, no human mouth or nose. Keep the big white ball head and tiny body throughout.
french-horn: A living GOLDEN FRENCH HORN: clearly recognizable circular coiled brass tubing, central cluster of three small rotary valves and levers, narrow curved mouthpipe with a small mouthpiece, and one broad flared bell. Not a trumpet, not a tuba, not a saxophone. Big expressive cartoon eyes and small talking mouth on the round coil/bell area, two thin dark cartoon arms with simple cream gloves, little feet. Clean clipart-like silhouette rendered as crisp pixel art with only a few gold shading tones. No human carrying it.
sixteenth-note: A living SINGLE SIXTEENTH NOTE, an unmistakable black musical symbol: ONE solid filled oval notehead lower-left, ONE straight vertical stem rising from the RIGHT of the notehead, and EXACTLY TWO short curved flags at the top of the stem, both extending RIGHT. Not an eighth note, not a beamed pair, not three flags. Friendly expressive eyes and small mouth on the oval notehead, tiny cartoon arms and feet. Dark navy-black silhouette with subtle cool-blue highlights. Keep stem short enough for the entire symbol to stay well below the top10% reserved space in every cell.
red-bearded-dragon: A real-world red-orange bearded dragon lizard, an especially warm rust-red and tangerine color morph with pale cream belly. Broad triangular reptile head, unmistakable spiky beard and cheek scales, dark glossy round eyes, squat scaly torso, four short clawed legs and one long tapering tail. Cute realistic reptile proportions rendered as expressive pixel art. No wings, horns, clothing, human body, or fantasy dragon anatomy.
banana-ball-python: A cute realistic BANANA MORPH BALL PYTHON, a small stout-bodied python with buttery yellow and pale lavender-tan blotched pattern, a few tiny dark freckles, a soft cream underside, a blunt little snake head, round dark eyes, one continuous legless body and tapering tail. The snake is loosely coiled in one compact mound, head raised gently at the front. Absolutely NO arms, NO legs, NO ears, NO cobra hood, NO dragon horns. Clear snake coils, no extra heads or disconnected body pieces.
kirby: Kirby, faithfully recognizable classic Nintendo pink spherical character: simple round rosy-pink body, two oval blue-dark eyes, tiny smiling mouth, small rosy cheek marks, two short round pink arm nubs and two large red oval feet. Cute clean iconic Kirby proportions with no hair, clothing, nose, fingers, extra limbs or accessories. Bright pink sphere and red feet stay consistent. Classic clean game pixel-art shading.
